subject: POC weekly checkpoint: milestone run-rate & acceptance playbook
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ortiz <e.ortiz@quantah.com>, QuantaHealth Engineering <eng-team@quantah.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC weekly checkpoint: milestone run-rate & acceptance playbook

Hi Elena / QuantaHealth team —

Quick weekly MAP checkpoint for the POC. I captured the core milestones and where we stand below; please flag any misalignment. Goals this week are to confirm the latency run-rate baseline and lock the acceptance checks so we can close the readiness gate in the runbook.

Milestones (owner — ETA)
- Data onboarding & access (Marissa Cole) — 2026-03-24
- Ingestion / eval harness ready (Vivek Kulkarni) — 2026-03-25
- Latency baseline & perf run (Redwood / QuantaHealth joint) — 2026-03-26
- Acceptance checklist complete & sign-off (Elena / QH) — 2026-03-29

Acceptance criteria (high level)
- API latency p50 < 120ms for 2k concurrent simulated users; no p95 regressions > 300ms during sustained run.
- End-to-end correctness: pass 95% of the smoke prompt set (eval_criteria.md attached).
- No critical security blockers on data access or encryption in transit.

Current blockers
- QuantaHealth needs a production-like traffic feed for latency validation (Elena noted this in kickoff).
- Minor schema mismatch on patient-id field for two message types (Marissa is triaging).

Requests / asks
1) Elena — can you confirm whether the traffic feed will be available by 3/25 or if we should synthetic-generate traffic for the latency run?
2) Marissa / Vivek — please confirm owners for schema fix and the ingestion pod config; attach any short notes to the MAP spreadsheet.

Attachments: QH_MAP_v2.xlsx, eval_criteria.md (linked below)

Proposed next steps: 30-min sync tomorrow to validate ingestion and finalize the perf window. If the traffic feed is delayed we will fallback to synthetic traffic with a plan to rerun once QH feed is available.

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference

From: Elena Ortiz <e.ortiz@quantah.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: QuantaHealth Engineering <eng-team@quantah.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Mar 2026 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC weekly checkpoint: milestone run-rate & acceptance playbook

Jordan — thanks for the clear summary. Two quick notes from our side: 

1) The production traffic feed will be available but we have a dependent change in our anonymization pipeline that isn't scheduled until late on 3/25. That means we cannot run full production-like traffic before 3/26.
2) We are OK with a synthetic run for initial latency validation, but would like the final acceptance perf run to be with production feed (target 3/27).

Can we move the Latency baseline & perf run target to 3/27 (final acceptance) and do a synthetic smoke run on 3/25? If so, we should record that in the MAP so sign-off dates reflect the two-step approach.

Elena Ortiz
Director, Integrations
QuantaHealth

- 2026-03-27: Production-fed perf acceptance run (owner: Redwood + QuantaHealth) — objective: final p50/p95 acceptance and throughput verification.

On the schema mismatch: I'm already working with your eng team on a small change to accept the patient-id as string|int and will push a patch to the ingestion adaptor by EOD tomorrow. Vivek, please confirm you can stand up the synthetic generator and share the run config in the drive link below.

Great — thanks all for the quick alignment. Summary of updated plan (I'll update the MAP spreadsheet and HubSpot record):

- 2026-03-25: Synthetic perf smoke run (owner: Vivek Kulkarni) — generate 2k concurrent synthetic users, capture p50/p95 and traces.
- 2026-03-26: Ingestion / eval harness final validation (owner: Marissa Cole) — confirm schema patch and data transform; smoke checks green.
- 2026-03-27: Production-fed acceptance perf run & sign-off (owners: Redwood eng + QuantaHealth) — final acceptance gate.

Action items assigned:
- Vivek Kulkarni: push synthetic generator config to drive and schedule 3/25 run (drive link above).
- Marissa Cole: push ingestion adaptor patch and confirm transform pipeline by 3/26.
- Elena / QH: confirm anonymization pipeline completion by 3/26 EOD and be ready for 3/27 run.

I'll book a 30-min sync for 3/25 09:00 PT to validate the synthetic run plan and show the run checklist. Final acceptance meeting tentatively 3/27 10:00 PT — please confirm availability.
